tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find official health datasets (Eurostat, OECD, World Bank, IMF, WHO, national statistics offices). Use first to get dataset ids. Optional country and source filters. Returns dataset cards, not values.

tools.name: inspect_dataset
tools.description: Show one dataset's dimensions, default series and the latest few values for a country. Use after search_catalog to check the dataset fits before pulling the full series.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Full metadata for one dataset: description, source, period range, dimension labels, default view and covered countries.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: Time series values for one country from a dataset (oldest first). Optionally pick a series by exact dimension values (from inspect_dataset) and a start period such as 2015, Q1/2015 or 01/2015.
